people.her: a young woman with long dark red hair, bare arms, a fitted leather and steel armoured bodice with round steel pauldrons
people.town: a small walled frontier town in early morning: timber and stone houses, a dozen chimneys smoking straight up in still air, a well in a small square, long blue shadows, low sun from the east
people.rook: Mother Rook, a broad grey-haired innkeeper woman in a leather apron with her arms folded, standing in an inn doorway
people.guard: a town watchman in a padded coat and iron helmet leaning on a spear

shots.B1: extreme long shot just inside a town's south gate looking north up the main road: {town}; to the right a tall stone toll tower with the sun on it and in its high window, very small, an oil lamp still burning pale in daylight; {her} walking in under the camera, small, seen from behind
shots.B2: medium shot from behind the shoulder of {guard} at a town gate, watching a red-haired armoured woman walk away up the road into the town, morning light
shots.B3: medium long shot tracking behind {her} walking up a town street in the morning: ahead of her people stopping to stare, a man carrying a ladder turning so it swings, a woman at a well holding her bucket halfway, a child running
shots.B4: medium shot beside an inn door, {rook} soft in the foreground right; in focus beyond her, a red-haired armoured woman stopped at the edge of a small square, looking round at the faces; morning
shots.B4a: telephoto close-up of a high stone tower window in full morning sun: on the sill a small lamp, its flame pale in the daylight, just going out with a thin thread of smoke
shots.B4b: medium shot: {rook} in her inn doorway looking at someone off screen, unfolding her arms, morning light
shots.B5: high angle rising over a small town square in the morning: a red-haired armoured woman standing in it, an innkeeper in her doorway, chimney smoke, long shadows
